description: A crowd of young men and women in white kurtas, dhotis and saris marches arm in arm down a narrow old-city street, holding a large blank white banner on bamboo poles and blank placards. A line of helmeted police stands in haze at the far end. Shopfronts on both sides carry signs with script-like lettering. Dark painterly oil style, edge to edge, no frame, no violence.
